result.reason: The operative language does not reach the playbook position. It ambiguously provides both renewal “only by mutual written agreement” and automatic renewal, while the automatic-renewal option requires 90 days’ notice, exceeding the 60-day fallback maximum, and includes no compliant price-increase cap or Vendor reminder. It also conflicts with Sections II and III, which continue to require mutual written agreement. The margin comment does not cure these defects. Although unrelated termination rights are preserved, the renewal revision is internally inconsistent and not professionally drafted.
